name: Agent Weather
description: Pay-per-request JSON conditions report on the AI-agent ecosystem, framed as weather. Covers agent-framework GitHub repos, AI provider status and outages, MCP Registry activity, npm adoption of MCP and x402 packages, and XRPL mainnet health, with sources, timestamps, data gaps and a modeled confidence score. Paid in XRP or RLUSD over x402 on the XRP Ledger.

resources.name: Agent Weather: current conditions
resources.description: Current conditions snapshot: GitHub stats for 6 agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, MCP servers), OpenAI/Anthropic/GitHub/Cursor status and incidents, MCP Registry entries updated in the last hour, npm weekly downloads (@modelcontextprotocol/sdk, @x402/core, @x402/xrpl) and XRPL mainnet server_info. Weather-style indices (visibility, pressure), per-source timestamps, data gaps and modeled confidence. JSON, cached up to 5 minutes.
